evidence: Draft clause reconciliation and specified source vectors only. Closed means the owned clause side is present, subject to review. No runtime, format execution, renderer, performance or owner-approval result is claimed.

assumes.assumed: Use the integrator working forms for entry/exit, Position/Context, shared action chain, admission/receipt binding, ActionHint, filter freshness, publication and component codes. They are not owner decisions.
assumes.if_other: Reconcile the clauses, command rows and durable format together before adoption; keep A5 refusals and current-context preservation.

assumes.assumed: Branch navigation and finishing separately pinned jobs remain conditional under JI.49 and LI.38. Normal revision-bound jobs are cancelled.
assumes.if_other: Without branches, remove branch-switch availability and use separate research sessions; cancelling pinned jobs ends them on replacement. Undo and monotone void facts remain.

assumes.assumed: The flat ia16 draft uses FP.13 tagged annotation targets and FP.30-FP.32 for durable encoding; p7-data changes those files in parallel.
assumes.if_other: A narrower or deferred envelope keeps literal chronology, typed pins and entry/exit evidence; no format is frozen by this packet.

assumes.assumed: The existing live-turn working reading and solver-initiated preview traces remain conditional; no shown-preview replacement policy is chosen.
assumes.if_other: Preview-every-turn routes live turns through presentation and commit; the owner-selected replacement policy may add its gate. Both keep tokens and exact freshness.

assumes.assumed: JI.37-JI.49 and LI.38 retain menu, scramble, renderer, boundary, placement and design alternatives; the owner_items below are carried forward without decisions.
assumes.if_other: Apply an explicit recorded owner answer only within its scope, then revise the affected gates, pins or adapters and evidence; no UI or DT-J2-DT-J4 work starts here.

Q7(a) remains pending EN2 XM1; only the owner can replace it with a kept alternative.
The owner confirms whether S4 requires a preview for live turns.
Program replacement of a presented preview remains with the owner and design line; no replacement policy is enabled here.
Entry filters, layout, look, motion and repair-list presentation await owner resumption and sign-off.
The owner selects the data-core scope; choosing EN3 flat storage is not acceptance of the format freeze.

owner_items.item: JI.48 / LQ1, LQ2, LQ16 and LQ21

Experiment branches and pinned-job policy are still owner alternatives.
Built-in implementation, engine language and route/placement are not selected by the batch signatures.
The admitted feature surface, renderer selection and presentation ownership remain their existing owner decisions.
Any proposal to admit labels-only entry or revive an exit through restore would change A5. This draft keeps both refused and requests no such change.
The design line must choose shown-preview replacement policy and any presentation delay; LI.38 preserves both options.
Only the owner can confirm the S4 reading for a live twist or require a preview for every turn.

owner_items.why: Branch versus separate-session policy and whether pinned jobs finish remain conditional owner choices.
View hosts, chart scope and renderer handoff/disposition remain owner choices; no UI or renderer selection is made.
Runtime placement, storage scope and boundary policy need the owner's existing decision procedures; these logical interfaces choose none.
Experiment authority, charter ordering, acceptance and freeze sign-off are absent from this source-only packet, as LI.37 records.

handoff_changes.change: Clarify that transition.action classifies the effect, not the command row kind. The existing non-undoable session.checkpoint.save commit row uses action=workspace for its non-puzzle durable effect and records no eligible inverse (LI.9, JI.27).
handoff_changes.why: The retained checkpoint-save row changes no puzzle Position but must remain in the durable order and retain its committed receipt. The H11 action vocabulary has no checkpoint-save tag; adding a command kind or a new action tag is unnecessary. p7-data must allow explicit absence of the inverse for this existing non-undoable case.

vector.given: Undoable action 41 is followed by checkpoint save 42 at head h/state7/context P0/B, with all gates passing and no puzzle mutation.
vector.expected: Save keeps Position/Context and state7, appends sequence42/action=workspace with its checkpoint record and no eligible inverse, and retains committed(command42,request42). The next undo hint has order42/target41; it does not invert the save.

handoff_changes.who: p7-data and the integrator: preserve this existing row kind while encoding its transition and absent inverse.

new_error_codes.meaning: The submitted FilterPreviewRef no longer matches epoch, identity, mode, state or resolved-filter dependencies; no word-preview slot or presentation is involved. H15.16 assigns registration to p7-reg.

rebind_undo_walk.given: The current latest workspace action is grip.rebind, which changed map A to B. Current workspace=10, map record version=4, state=7, head=h7 and puzzle hash=L. session.undo supplies the current ActionHint and valid token; gates pass.
rebind_undo_walk.expected: Internal workspace dispatch restores A; Receipt.status=committed, CommitRecord.pre=post=L, head=h7 and state=7. Workspace becomes 11 and map record version 5. slot_map=by_target permits this restoration. Redo with a fresh hint restores B and advances workspace to 12/version 6.

conflicting_preview_then_commit.given: A complete mechanically admissible retained word moves a protected labelled orbit. Current dependencies are unchanged. operation.preview has all other gates passing; then an otherwise valid operation.execute request reaches the protection check.
conflicting_preview_then_commit.expected: Preview returns completed(preview_ready), with its protection field reporting the conflict. Execute is refused(KN2:protection.orbit_would_move); head and state stay unchanged. A mechanically blocked prefix instead builds no preview.

budget_exhausted_query_receipt.given: Accepted jumble.observe cQ/job jQ exhausts its deterministic output allowance after seam coverage [0,2), before covering the full set. Its terminal notification is lost in the same engine epoch.
budget_exhausted_query_receipt.expected: Receipt cQ is cancelled(budget); JobResult cQ/jQ is cut_off(KN7:budget.output), with covered=[0,2) and total_N undefined. outcome(cQ,requestQ) returns that same cancellation, not completed(query). After epoch loss with no retained transient terminal, it returns unknown_outcome.

partial_value_within_grant.given: A query result type declares named-scope partial coverage as a normal result. The job completes that declared scope within every grant while the broader total remains unexamined.
partial_value_within_grant.expected: JobResult.outcome=completed and Receipt.status=completed(query) may carry that typed partial value. Its uncovered total stays undefined and supplies no complete negative claim. This is not a cut_off outcome.

crossing_on_branch_path_context.given: E2 recorded preferences A and protection P0. Current preferences are B and protection P1. A proved branch path crosses E2 into its off target Position; all current protection checks pass and none of these crossings recorded a protection change.
crossing_on_branch_path_context.expected: The target head/mode/episode/state are restored from that journal path; preferences remain B and protection P1. The branch transition records actual context_before/context_after=B/P1, not E2 historical A/P0. E2 supplies the exit root only if unvoided.

entry_after_retained_move.given: Exit E at e stores exact poses X. Retained word w leads off to head h9 and labels Lw. Entry I at h10 starts episode J at Z=replay(X,w), binding exit_root(E,e,digest(w)); E remains unvoided.
entry_after_retained_move.expected: Undo I restores its own off before Position h9/Lw and pre-entry episode, not E pre-exit on-state X. Redo I validates its entrance and restores h10/J/Z. Both advance state revision with new receipts; recovery after either yields that last complete Position and actual Context.

entry_solved_witness.given: An import voided earlier exits and supplies complete retained v from solved reaching labels Lv at off head h20. New entry I records solved_witness(v), on head h21, episode J and poses Z=replay(solved,v).
entry_solved_witness.expected: I requires no ExitRecord. Undo returns off to h20/Lv and its recorded pre-entry episode; redo returns on to h21/J/Z. Recovery uses I own sides and v, never an old exit side or a pose lift of Lv.

outcome_lookup_after_undo.given: Crossing command C/request R durably committed at state revision 32. Notification was lost. Undo U then restores the earlier Position at revision 33 and the engine restarts; both durable records remain.
outcome_lookup_after_undo.expected: outcome(C,R) returns C original committed receipt and its original RevisionRef at state=32. U has a distinct command/action/receipt at state=33. No crossing is executed again and the current hash is not used to infer C outcome.

admission_proved_rollback.given: Commit C has a durable admission binding command/request, but its transaction did not commit. Complete recovery proves rollback and no publication.
admission_proved_rollback.expected: outcome(C,requestC) is failed(KN5:resource_limit.engine_lost). Prior Position/Context and exit validity remain; there is no transition or automatic retry. Without proof, the outcome is unknown_outcome and a possible mutation requires read-only recovery.

exit_protection_edit_undo.given: Exit action 40 ends at head e/state=32/workspace=10/protection=2 with P0 and preferences B. Workspace action 41 adds P1. Retained move 42 follows. Fresh hints/tokens and all gates, including protection-release confirmation, allow undo of 42 and then 41.
exit_protection_edit_undo.expected: 41 leaves Position fixed at e/state32 and advances workspace=11/protection=3. 42 moves to m/state33. Undo43 returns e/state34, keeping P1/B and workspace11/protection3. Undo44 restores P0/B at workspace12/protection4, keeping e/state34 and equal puzzle hashes. Recovery checks consecutive Position/Context links and returns E/root P with empty suffix.

inactive_exit_void_survives_break_undo.given: E1 is active and earlier E2 is inactive on another branch. Reset action R replaces the state. The solver undoes R and later selects an old branch; recovery has both void facts.
inactive_exit_void_survives_break_undo.expected: R voids both E1 and E2 in its transaction. Undo, branch selection and equal labels erase neither void. A path that would reactivate either exit is refused(KN5:input.exit_record_voided); labels-only Jumble entry is refused(KN5:input.jumble_on_labels_only).

hint_order_42_target_41.given: Action 41 is undoable; non-undoable action 42 is current. session.undo carries hint={order:42,target:41} and a token bound to both fields. Compare admission before and after a separate action 43 lands, with all other gates passing.
hint_order_42_target_41.expected: Before 43, the hint selects 41 and its inverse can commit. After 43, the same order42/target41 hint gets refused(KN5:stale.undo_superseded), even if 41 remains eligible. No inverse or revision change is written by that refused call.

filter_apply_without_word_preview.given: FilterPreviewRef f belongs to the current session/epoch, identity/mode/state=7 and resolved filter F. No word preview is pending or presented. filter.apply has its other gates passing. Then the state changes to 8, or a record read by F is edited.
filter_apply_without_word_preview.expected: The first apply satisfies fresh_filter_preview and returns completed(workspace). The old f after either relevant change is refused(KN5:stale.filter_preview); no new filter action is written. An unread workspace edit alone keeps filter_fresh(f)=true. No no_fresh_preview error is used for a missing word preview.

two_binding_overlay.given: Captured availability has (K,A)=available and (K,B)=unavailable(KN2:input.named_object_invalid). K argument-independent gates and the overlay own gates/grants/static verdict pass. Compare requires entries static A, static B and computed.
two_binding_overlay.expected: Static A makes the overlay available; static B makes it unavailable(KN2:input.named_object_invalid). Computed makes it available from row-level gates without choosing either cached binding or running language code. If it later computes B, invoke refuses that argument.

same_and_different_target.given: In session S, unfinished A resolves lane_target to view V. B declares {arg:view}, its view argument is V, and C declares {view:W}. Both new requests pass admission; W differs from V.
same_and_different_target.expected: B shares S/view V with A and A becomes cancelled(superseded(by=B)); A cannot publish late. C uses S/view W and runs independently without cancelling B. A control target named V is a distinct namespace. Each resolved target participates in its request binding.

scheduled_final_validation_failed.given: View A is pending. Scheduled B is accepted for the same target, supersedes A, then computes 5 instances under ceiling 4. Separately, standalone B arrives with the same 5-instance payload already present before admission.
scheduled_final_validation_failed.expected: Scheduled B ends failed(EV3:resource_limit.display_plan_ceiling) on its original command/job, JobResult.outcome=error; A stays cancelled(superseded(by=B)). No second lane admission or installation occurs. Standalone B is refused with the same code before acceptance and leaves A untouched.

renderer_lost_after_acceptance.given: Publication C is running(job J) when the renderer is lost before installation. Compare the same unavailable service before acceptance and device loss after a publication was installed.
renderer_lost_after_acceptance.expected: During accepted preparation C is failed(EV3:busy.renderer_unavailable) and J has outcome=error with that code/category=busy/form=stop; no installation. Before acceptance the receipt is refused and form=refusal. After installation the original completed(view_published) remains unchanged.

ji23_relation.given: In the pinned menu, annotations ordered A/B/C span [0,1)/[1,2)/[2,3). A covers item12; B same_as and C inverse_of use relation.word={local:A}. Payload is [(0,12),(0,12),(0,45)].
ji23_relation.expected: Both targets resolve earlier A; the relations pass with length3, hex0c000c002d00 and digest c2ae6cf7df4e002e34b55017aa22a79d7b385830a0cf513f170586410380d309. A missing target, A-to-C forward/cyclic reference or C replaced by item12 refuses annotation admission. part/ref alternatives require pinned complete closure and never generate letters.

branch_path_envelope.given: A branch switch from hA to hB has no proved path link at admission. Frames are known and the current draft D is retained.
branch_path_envelope.expected: Refused with code=KN4:input.branch_path_unproved, category=input, raising component=KN4, form=refusal, recoverable=true, retry=after_user_change. Context names hA/hB, the missing/unproved link and retained D. Head/context/root stay unchanged; supply a proved path or explicitly restore with voids, not a missing-frame remedy.

void_exit_envelope.given: Redo targets crossing e/exit E, but durable void V from restore R names E. Exact frames and poses exist; draft D remains.
void_exit_envelope.expected: Refused with code=KN5:input.exit_record_voided, category=input, raising component=KN5, form=refusal, recoverable=true, retry=after_user_change. Context includes E/e, target action, V/R and D. E stays void; only a separate fresh crossing or solved-witness entry can establish new authority.

exposed_geometry_envelope.given: A request for exposed_faces at exact StateRef S has known frames/IDs but no certified mesh and no admitted size profile. There is no draft.
exposed_geometry_envelope.expected: Refused with code=KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable, category=input, raising component=KN2, form=refusal, recoverable=true, retry=after_user_change. Context names exposed_faces/S, both missing prerequisites and explicit absent draft. Feature stays unavailable; no fabricated mesh/size or request for a disambiguating frame.

scrub_citation.given: The solver scrubs a jumbling preview using its PreviewId and literal position; a newer request for the same resolved target arrives while the first is unfinished. Separately a solving caller requests a hidden scramble prefix.
scrub_citation.expected: The command is view.preview.scrub, shared by arguments and cited by CT-JI-07; the older view job is superseded without a puzzle commit. Hidden scramble letters/prefixes remain inaccessible through scrub, entrance, receipt or generic journal queries.

p7-reg registers H15.16; p1 now proposes six component codes and reuses two existing EV3 codes. Register the filter code above and add CT-JI-08..11 at LP1 and CT-LI-09..14 at LP2 to chapter 12; these ten rows extend the prior requirement inventory.

p7-data must encode both entry bindings, Position/Context, workspace inverses and admission/terminal references in FP.30-FP.32 and encode JI.23 tagged relations in examples.json. Verify the combined H13 trace and the source vectors; they are specifications, not executed product tests.
Keep all owner questions and broader partial p1/p2b findings open pending their named evidence and decisions. No A5, DT-J1, menu or human-solve boundary change is requested.
The integrator reviews Codex-authored changes and arranges the required independent current-candidate review; no model call or review artifact was created in this no-network sandbox.
